description: Source code for a Bluetooth periodic advertising response synchronization demo using Zephyr RTOS, including callback implementations, GATT service definition, and main execution loop.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when synchronization to periodic advertising is established.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when synchronization is terminated.

methods.name: print_ad_field
methods.description: Function to print advertising data fields.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when a periodic advertising packet is received.

methods.name: write_timing
methods.description: GATT characteristic write handler to update timing parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializing Bluetooth, setting up synchronization, and managing advertising loop.
